FROM CONTEXT TO CHANGE

Less switching.
More understanding.

Keep the repository, the review, and the work connected.

01 / FIND

Start with what needs you.

Home brings together watched repositories, contribution history, and recent activity. Open the pull requests you authored or were asked to review.

02 / REVIEW

See the whole change.

Read patches beside checks and conversation. Comment, approve, and merge through explicit actions, or open GitHub in the embedded browser.

03 / DEVELOP

Give each task room to work.

Run Codex or Claude in a separate local worktree. Follow the transcript, handle approvals, steer an active turn, and queue the next request.

A DESKTOP APP, THROUGH AND THROUGH

Your Mac is
the workspace.

Application state lives in SQLite on your Mac. The interface talks to a local backend, and agent tasks run in managed Git worktrees.

GitHub and your selected model provider remain external services. Local-first means local ownership of app state and execution, with clear network boundaries.
